YANG.gloss: the bright positive masculine principle in Chinese dualistic cosmology
YANG.definition: The bright positive masculine principle in Chinese dualistic cosmology.
YANG.example: Yin and yang together produce everything that comes into existence.

GAY.definition: Bright and pleasant; promoting a feeling of cheer.

TAG.gloss: attach a tag or label to
TAG.definition: Attach a tag or label to.

ANY.gloss: one or some or every or all without specification
ANY.definition: One or some or every or all without specification.
ANY.example: Give me any peaches you don't want.

TAN.gloss: a browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun
TAN.definition: A browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun.

ANT.gloss: social insect living in organized colonies
ANT.definition: Social insect living in organized colonies; characteristically the males and fertile queen have wings during breeding season; wingless sterile females are the workers.
